metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-84869: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to file transfer and execution through an active remote sessions without authorization or host confirmation.. Product: ScreenConnect
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-84869" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-84869" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-84869" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-GENERAL-001
